headlines.title: The massive risk hiding inside your S&P 500 index fund
headlines.summary: The Bahnsen Group Chief Investment Officer David Bahnsen and Roundhill Investments Chief Investment Strategist Drew Pettit discuss the hidden dangers of top-heavy passive index funds.

headlines.title: Skydance Rises 5% as Steep Post-Merger Slide Pauses; Disney Gains 2%, Netflix Slips
headlines.summary: Skydance shares staged a sharp single-day reversal after weeks of relentless post-merger selling, but whether buyers or sellers control the newly combined studio giant depends on what the integration numbers reveal next.

headlines.title: Disney (DIS): Should It Invest More in Cruise Ships or Theme Parks?
headlines.summary: The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) is expanding its cruise fleet while travel demand remains resilient and operating costs rise. Familiar characters can sell vacations, but ships create shareholder value only when fares cover construction, operations, and continuing investment. The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) has a forward P/E of 14x versus 21x trailing.

headlines.title: Shutterfly Named the Official Photo Gift Partner of Walt Disney World® Resort, Disneyland® Resort, Disney Cruise Line®, and Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa
headlines.summary: Shutterfly and Disney today announced a strategic alliance that names Shutterfly the Official Photo Gift Partner of Walt Disney World® Resort, Disneyland Resort, Disney Cruise Line, and Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, creating a more connected way for guests to turn their Disney memories into personalized keepsakes. The alliance brings together two brands focused on helping people preserve memories and celebrate life's meaningful moments.

headlines.title: Trump Likes Walt Disney (DIS). Time to Buy The Stock?
headlines.summary: The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) ranks first on our list of the top 10 stocks in Trump’s latest stock portfolio. Trump’s portfolio added Disney in three August buys. He sold Disney in July, and billionaire funds were selling it too. Click to read why. Is the stock worth buying now?

description: The Walt Disney Company operates as an entertainment company in Americas, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It operates in three segments: Entertainment, Sports, and Experiences. The company produces and distributes film and television content under the ABC Television Network, Disney, Freeform, FX, Fox, National Geographic, and Star brand television channels, as well as ABC television stations and A+E television networks; and produces original content under the Disney Branded Television, FX Productions, Lucasfilm, Marvel, National Geographic Studios, Pixar, Searchlight Pictures, Twentieth Century Studios, 20th Television, and Walt Disney Pictures banners. It also provides direct-to-consumer streaming services through Disney+, Disney+ Hotstar, and Hulu; sports-related video streaming content through ESPN, ESPN on ABC, ESPN+ DTC, and Star; sale/licensing of film and episodic content to television and video-on-demand services; theatrical, home entertainment, and music distribution services; DVD and Blu-ray discs, electronic home video licenses, and VOD rental services; staging and licensing of live entertainment events; and post-production services. In addition, the company operates theme parks and resorts, such as Walt Disney World Resort, Disneyland Resort, Disneyland Paris, Hong Kong Disneyland Resort, Shanghai Disney Resort, Disney Cruise Line, Disney Vacation Club, National Geographic Expeditions, and Adventures by Disney, as well as Aulani, a Disney resort and spa in Hawaii. Further, it licenses its intellectual property (IP) to a third party that owns and operates Tokyo Disney Resort; licenses trade names, characters, visual, literary, and other IP for use on merchandise, published materials, and games; operates a direct-to-home satellite distribution platform; sells branded merchandise through retail, online, and wholesale businesses; and develops and publishes books, comic books, and magazines. The company was founded in 1923 and is based in Burbank, California.
